title: Yanomami wusinari insect beings and multitudinous dancing spirits

tellings.quote: were talking about um the Yanomami for example had these these beings which which they called the wusinari insect beings

plain: The Yanomami, a people of the Amazon rainforest, describe beings they call the wusinari, insect-like beings, among crowds of dancing spirits. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore brings this up, without naming a source, while talking about the psychedelic drug DMT. He mentions it because such beings resemble the ones people report meeting on DMT.
